cleaning_rules_justification.duplicate_review_id: 0 repeated review_id values; review_id is the primary key, so only the first occurrence is kept.
cleaning_rules_justification.short_or_empty_text: 19 reviews with fewer than 10 characters carry no usable text for the rating model; dropped.
cleaning_rules_justification.duplicate_text: 198 reviews repeat an earlier text exactly (copy-pasted reviews). Keeping them would put identical texts in train and test (leakage); dropped.
cleaning_rules_justification.invalid_stars: 0 reviews had a star value outside the integers 1–5; dropped.
cleaning_rules_justification.invalid_or_out_of_range_date: 0 reviews had an unparseable date or one outside 2004-10-01–2022-12-31; dropped.
cleaning_rules_justification.orphan_keys: 0 reviews point to an unknown business and 5 to an unknown user; dropped so that SQL foreign keys hold.
cleaning_rules_justification.vote_winsorisation: 76 reviews have more than 100 useful/funny/cool votes (max 997). The 99.9th percentile of useful votes is 32.0, so a cap of 100 only touches extreme viral reviews; they are kept but capped so means are not dominated by a handful of rows.
cleaning_rules_justification.text_length_outliers: 46,701 reviews (6.01%) are above the IQR fence for length (1456 chars). Long reviews are genuine (Yelp allows 5,000 chars), so they are kept.
cleaning_rules_justification.business_city_normalisation: City names were trimmed, title-cased and 'St./St' unified to 'Saint': 1,416 spellings -> 1,215.
cleaning_rules_justification.business_missing_categories: 103 businesses have no categories; labelled 'Uncategorized' so they still join.
cleaning_rules_justification.price_range: 65,066 businesses have no RestaurantsPriceRange2 attribute; left as NULL instead of inventing a value.

reviews_memory_optimization.note: Review text dominates memory and cannot be downcast; the dtype gain is visible on the other columns (int64->int8/int16, date string->int16 year/int8 month, id strings->category).
